name: IBY_IBAN_COUNTRY_STRUCTURE
description: This table contains IBAN structure  based on country.

columns.name: IBAN_COUNTRY_STRUCTURE_ID
columns.description: Primary key. Internal identifier generated by system.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Unique ISO 3166-1 country code prefix in IBAN. Each country must have only one record.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE_POSITION
columns.description: Starting position of country code in IBAN.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of characters in country code of IBAN.

columns.name: IBAN_CHECK_DIGIT_POSITION
columns.description: Starting position of IBAN check digit.

columns.name: IBAN_CHECK_DIGIT_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of characters in IBAN check digit.

columns.name: BANK_IDENTIFIER_POSITION
columns.description: Starting position of bank identifier in IBAN.

columns.name: BANK_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of characters in bank identifier of IBAN.

columns.name: BRANCH_IDENTIFIER_POSITION
columns.description: Starting position of branch identifier in IBAN. Value is empty if branch identifier is not applied in country's IBAN format.

columns.name: BRANCH_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of characters in branch identifier of IBAN. Value is 0 if branch identifier is not applied in country's IBAN format.

columns.name: NATIONAL_ID_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of significant characters in National Identifier value used by SWIFT to populate IBAN National Identifier, which derives the IBAN BIC correctly.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER_POSITION
columns.description: Starting position of account number in IBAN.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of characters in account number of IBAN.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CHECK_DIGIT_POSITION
columns.description: Starting position of check digit in account number.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CHECK_DIGIT_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of characters in check digit of account number.

columns.name: TOTAL_LENGTH
columns.description: Total number of characters in IBAN.

columns.name: SEPA_COUNTRY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the row country is within the SEPA zone. Yes if it is, No if it is not.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether structure is predefined or not: Yes if predefined. All values will be recorded with Yes now. Update as No if a row is subsequently entered or modified by customer.

columns.name: OPTIONAL_COMMENCE_DATE
columns.description: Date from which IBAN can be used in customer credit payments.

columns.name: MANDATORY_COMMENCE_DATE
columns.description: Date from which IBAN must be used in customer credit payments.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
